paper.title: Neural Network for Predicting Stroke Team Performance
paper.doi: not reported (no article record found; Code Ocean capsule 3269870)

claims.text: A three-layer TensorFlow network trained on four features (hour of day, age, duration, NIHSS severity) predicts door-to-needle time >45 min with precision 63%, recall 67%, F1 64% and accuracy 60% on the validation set.
The network was trained on historical data and validated on a separate set.
With the four parameters, though individually having a weak association, the neural network was able to construct a reasonable prediction model for stroke team performance.
The capsule reproduces the published results (REPRODUCING.md: run.sh reproduces the results published by the author).
predict.js is a vanilla JavaScript implementation of the prediction using the trained weights, giving output 0/1 for a 4x1 input array.
